refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often Factory Lens refreshes machine diagnostics. Lower values react faster but use more CPU.

toggleKey.description: Unity KeyCode used to toggle the map overlay. Examples: LeftAlt, F7, BackQuote.

panelKey.description: Unity KeyCode used to open or close the Factory Lens diagnostics window.

inputStarvationPercent.description: An input buffer at or below this percentage is considered at risk for truck logistics.

outputBlockedPercent.description: An output buffer at or above this percentage is considered blocked for truck logistics.

maxMapIcons.description: Maximum Factory Lens icons visible at once. Limits overhead on very large islands.

showPausedMachines.description: Show deliberately paused machines in Problems mode.

showMapIcons.description: Initial Alt overlay setting for native product or building icons. Can also be changed in the window.

showMapLabels.description: Initial Alt overlay setting for plain-language status labels. Can also be changed in the window.

windowOpacityPercent.description: Initial diagnostics-window opacity. The in-game slider saves later changes locally.

windowWidth.description: Initial diagnostics-window width. The in-game slider saves later changes locally.

historySampleSeconds.description: Seconds between samples in the dashboard history graph.

historySamples.description: Number of samples retained by the dashboard history graph.

stateGraceSeconds.description: How long a soft input-wait or full-output state must persist before it can become actionable.

predictionHorizonSeconds.description: How far ahead Factory Lens may warn about an input running out or an output filling up.

predictionObservationSeconds.description: Minimum continuous buffer trend observation before a forecast is shown.

inputCyclesWarning.description: Warn when a decreasing input buffer has at most this many recipe cycles left and no delivery is scheduled.

repeatWindowMinutes.description: Rolling window used to count repeated occurrences of the same problem.

language.description: Interface language catalog: auto, en, ru, or another catalog code added under Localization.
